messages:
Nora: Heads-up: small initiative request from two customers to make console cost signals actionable. Proposal: 4-week spike -> heatmap + "impact" export + lightweight trace hook. Thoughts?
Cam: +1. Keep it low-touch: aggregate rollups + sampled spans. Need strict ingest budget.
Jordan: UX ask: show estimated $/1000 tokens, top-3 contributing routes, and a quick-recommendation pill (e.g., 'try model-x q4 -> est -40% cost').
Len: Tracing plan: emit a minimal span with tags model, route, token_count, quant_variant. Default sampling 0.25%. If org enables, increase to 2%.
Maria: CS: customers want CSV and S3 export. Also request masking rules: remove prompt and user identifiers by default. Enterprise can opt-in for raw.
Nora: Draft launch criteria: feature parity for heatmap + export, sampling toggle in org settings, PII scrubbed by default, canary to 10% non-enterprise for 7 days.
Cam: Metric constraints: ingestion delta <4% during canary. Fallback: switch to per-minute aggregates and disable raw span export for heavy orgs.
Jordan: I'll wire telemetry: heatmap_views, export_downloads, spans_samples_rate, ingest_delta.
Len: Infra owners will prototype span schema and fallback logic this week.
DeployBot: canary rollout scheduled at 1823456800 :rocket:
Nora: OK nice. Next actions: Len + Cam produce infra estimate, Jordan mocks dashboard queries, Maria confirms two customers' export/PII needs. Follow-up in #product next Wed.
